text:
Lina: Post-RFC follow-up: proposing a minimal probe-first handshake shim as the default handoff surface across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Goal: remove the large, stateful facade that duplicates logic and causes long rollback windows. Shim responsibilities: health/capability probe, routing hints, request-id passthrough. No request transformation, no persistent cache.

Raj: sounds promising. two immediate risks: 1) secret injection for on-prem HSM workflows, 2) streaming/partial-chunk semantics changing. need mitigations for both.

Lina: mitigation plan sketch: HSM -> keep operator-managed injection for private (documented operator-side pattern + helm chart). For hosted/dedicated we'll support a controlled proxying header that signals to a dedicated secret-authorizer to perform short-lived token exchange. This avoids moving KMS keys into the shim.

Mei: on streaming: we must ensure chunk boundaries and carriage returns remain identical. propose a binary-equivalence test where we replay recorded streaming sessions through both surfaces and diff chunk boundaries + control frames. add that to harness.

Carlos: ops notes: rollout order needs to be conservative. suggested rollout phases:
- alpha: internal infra tenants in hosted only (feature flag)
- beta: selected dedicated tenants (opt-in)
- private: operator install + migration window (customer-driven)
- GA: flip default with a 90-day deprecation for the old facade
And require an emergency kill-switch routed at the LB to rebind traffic to legacy path.

Lina: agree. telemetry is critical: shim must be transparent for trace/span propagation. headers to preserve: X-Redwood-Req-Id, traceparent, and our internal x-rw-route-hint. shim will add x-rw-shim-diagnostic when enabled to surface probe decisions during canaries.

Raj: how will we prove parity? propose a test matrix: short-chat (<=128 tokens), long-prime (>=8k window), embeddings. traffic profile: synthetic tps buckets (100, 500, 1500) for 30m each. collect P50/P95/P99, error rates, token-cost-per-request, and observe streaming latencies. diff thresholds: no >3% regression on p95 and no new error classes.

Mei: plus quality hooks: sample 1000 real prompts and compare outputs token-for-token (for non-deterministic routes use similarity scoring with thresholds). also validate encoding by comparing lengths and serialized token IDs when possible.

Carlos: config drift and CI: add a manifest linter rule to flag deprecated facade-only keys and add a preflight validation step for Dedicated provisioning pipelines. Also include a migration warning in provisioning UI if a tenant relies on facade-only config.

Lina: compatibility: the shim will perform a capability handshake returning a small manifest: {"kv_layout": "v2", "streaming_mode": "framed"}. If runtime reports incompatible, shim annotates and either routes to legacy facade or returns a structured 409 with migration hint (configurable).

Raj: what about in-flight KV pointers if we flip? must avoid split-brain cache pointers. plan: grace period where facade continues to accept requests for marked tenants and a background reconciliation job migrates KV indexes. Ops must snapshot before flipping.

Carlos: ops-bot: create snapshot job and baseline metrics job?

ops-bot: created job: handoff-snapshot-180000 (store=longterm, retention=30d). baseline metrics job scheduled: handoff-parity-180000 (cadence=daily). link: https://ci.redwood/handoff-parity-180000

Lina: CI and PRs: we'll land prototype shim in an experimental package and a manifest linter in infra-lint. devex: add a short migration guide and a troubleshooting playbook (span correlation, secret flows, streaming mismatch).

Raj: add a step to security review for the operator install docs (HSM flows). Tagging @security for review.

Mei: timeline suggestion: prototype (10d) -> harness & parity tests (5d) -> hosted alpha (7d) -> dedicated beta opt-ins (14d) -> private operator docs & migration (10d) -> GA flip after 12w monitoring. keep canary window at least 2w for hosted alpha.

Carlos: ops OK. put me as approver for the LB kill-switch and snapshot verification.

deploy-bot: PR 4672 opened: "probe-shim: initial impl + handshake manifest" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4672

Lina: Ill write the rollout playbook and a short decision matrix mapping runtime capabilities to allowed route. Will also include an example helm chart for operator-side injection for private customers.

Raj: please include the exact headers to preserve and an observability checklist (what metrics to capture, prometheus queries, and dashboards to compare).

Mei: and include the streaming chunk diff tool in the harness repo with an example golden trace.

Lina: noted. I'll circle back with the draft doc and ping this thread for review. thanks everyone. :rocket:
